text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Someone who cleans the school campus 
diligently? Hmm... No one immediately 
comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, let me know if you 
spot it. I shall continue looking as well.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, understood!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now then... I should head over to the 
Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh? This poster is a little crooked... 
...Yep. That should do it!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Flight-chan. Even though I'm on 
duty today, I ended up having you help me 
put the balls away.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No. If the two of us do it together, we'll 
be done in no time♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oops, there's dirt on the ball...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Did you wipe it with your sleeve? 
That's pretty bold of you~."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it'll come right out in the wash, 
so... there, all clean and neat♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Blackboard check, erasers check... 
alright. Is it looking pretty clean now?

—Cleaning the blackboard even though it's 
not your turn for chores... You're quite 
hardworking.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san! What's the matter? Being 
in a place like this...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I told you before, didn't I? I'm 
looking for whoever's been cleaning the 
academy grounds."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
After asking around, I got an idea of 
where you'd be. That is why I came to see 
you directly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: To do this directly... wait.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh!? That... was about me!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What, you really didn't realize it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yeah. I wasn't really intending to 
clean in the first place.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I don't think to myself, 'Ugh, it's dirty' 
or 'It's messy.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's just that... I feel like it's not 
bringing out her original strengths—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"It felt disappointing that its 'natural 
radiance' wasn't brought out. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It felt less like "I was cleaning" and 
more like "I was coordinating"! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I see. So that was it...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing. I just happened to 
notice it the other day while cleaning to 
take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's not just tidied up... It's been 
cleaned so thoroughly that the place 
"shines." Apparently, more and more spots 
like that are popping up across the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's a subtle detail, but it comes down to 
a difference in mindset. Between "making 
it clean" and "making it shine."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I'll try shifting my perspective 
a bit too. Following your example.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a meeting with North Flight, Air 
Groove stopped by to deliver a notice from 
the Student Council.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As expected, even your Trainer's office is 
tidy. ...Is your Trainer a neat freak too?
choice_data_list:
...No, making a mess would probably be 
faster.
I think Ne is a neat freak!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Trainers are certainly like that.
choice_data_list: I do want to clean it up, but...
I do want to clean it up, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As things stand, I've let things get messy 
while caught up in work, so North Flight 
has been tidying up for me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm having fun doing it too, so it's 
completely fine, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fair enough, then... Just don't spoil them 
too much, alright?
choice_data_list: I'll do my best not to get spoiled...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we became much more mindful of 
keeping the room tidy than before.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Your desk is always so clean and tidy, 
Trainer! It's wonderful♪
choice_data_list:
Though sometimes the busyness gets the 
better of me...

Though sometimes the busyness gets the 
better of me...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, we should help each 
other out. Fortunately, you have someone 
beside you who shares your values.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right, Trainer. Please don't 
worry about it too much♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, thanks to North Flight, I 
was able to get my work done in complete 
comfort.
